comments.text:
Back in 1996 AT&T advertised the future of shopping. Fill the cart with groceries into bags, RFID tags were on all items, bring it to the front the whole cart would be scanned in seconds, pay and leave. Well this idea fell apart fast, hackers could sit outside a store and rewrite the tags with new prices and descriptions. 

New systems are going to be hacked and all hell is going to break loose on stores and consumers. 

I understand why stores want self checkout, employees don't always show up for work and can be rude. The hiring pool is getting smaller and smaller. Plus they don't always value good employees making them disgruntled.

Our society is hurting, needing help with a delicate balance of tech and human interaction. Gas stations started the self service market back in the 1970s.
